flowchart TD Boot["Start application and create static queues and tasks
firmware/app/app.c:250"] Boot --> Bind["Bind STM32 motor I/O platform
firmware/app/app.c:252"] Bind --> StartTasks["Create supervisor, command, UI, telemetry, health, and TX tasks
firmware/ap…"] StartTasks --> S1 StartTasks --> C1 StartTasks --> U1 StartTasks --> T1 StartTasks --> H1 StartTasks --> X1 subgraph SupervisorTask["Supervisor task"] S1["Bind hardware and initialize motor control
firmware/app/app.c:94"] S1 --> S2["Register fast-sample callback
firmware/app/app.c:99"] S2 --> S3["Wait until next 1 ms tick
firmware/app/app.c:101"] S3 --> S4["Run motor supervisor state transition tick
firmware/app/app.c:102"] S4 -->|1 ms| S3 end subgraph FastSampleISR["ADC sample interrupt"] I1["Handle ADC1 and ADC2 interrupt
Core/Src/stm32g4xx_it.c:139"] I1 --> I2["Deliver paired sample through motor I/O callback
firmware/interfaces/motor_…"] I2 --> I3["Validate samples and run fast motor control
firmware/modules/motor/motor_co…"] I3 --> I4{"Sample valid and no latched fault — firmware/modules/motor/motor_control.c:200"} I4 -->|valid| I5["Run FOC calculation and update PWM duties
firmware/modules/foc/foc.c:130"] I4 -->|invalid or fault| I6["Record fault or disable bridge
firmware/modules/motor/motor_control.c:200"] I5 --> I7["Write coherent TIM1 compare values
firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_hw.c:190"] end subgraph CommandTask["Command task"] C1["Poll buffered UART RX bytes and assemble a line
firmware/app/app.c:108"] C1 --> C2{"Complete line parses as a command — firmware/app/app.c:55"} C2 -->|yes| C3["Queue command for handling
firmware/app/app.c:124"] C2 -->|no| C4["Queue malformed-command reply
firmware/app/app.c:127"] C3 --> C5["Apply command and queue status reply
firmware/app/app.c:130"] C4 --> C6["Delay when no command work is available
firmware/app/app.c:160"] C5 --> C6 C6 --> C1 end subgraph UITask["UI task"] U1["Wait for UI period and read debounced button input
firmware/app/app.c:165"] U1 --> U2{"Button state changed after debounce — firmware/app/app.c:172"} U2 -->|released| U3["Clear fault, start from idle, or request stop
firmware/app/app.c:175"] U2 -->|no action| U4["Read motor snapshot and select LED indication
firmware/app/app.c:183"] U3 --> U4 U4 --> U5["Write status LED state
firmware/app/app.c:190"] U5 -->|20 ms| U1 end subgraph TelemetryTask["Telemetry task"] T1["Wait for telemetry period and read motor snapshot
firmware/app/app.c:192"] T1 --> T2["Format and enqueue CSV telemetry
firmware/app/app.c:197"] T2 --> T3{"Motor idle and potentiometer source is available — firmware/app/app.c:219"} T3 -->|yes| T4["Read potentiometer and update idle speed request
firmware/app/app.c:220"] T3 -->|no| T5["Wait for next telemetry interval
firmware/app/app.c:192"] T4 --> T5 T5 -->|100 ms| T1 end subgraph HealthTask["Health task"] H1["Wait for health period and read motor snapshot
firmware/app/app.c:231"] H1 --> H2{"Motor state is fault — firmware/app/app.c:234"} H2 -->|yes| H3["Disable bridge while fault is active
firmware/app/app.c:234"] H2 -->|no| H4["Continue monitoring"] H3 -->|10 ms| H1 H4 -->|10 ms| H1 end subgraph TxTask["UART transmit task"] X1["Prefer queued status reply over telemetry
firmware/app/app.c:241"] X1 --> X2{"Message received and UART TX is available — firmware/app/app.c:243"} X2 -->|yes| X3["Transmit queued message through motor I/O
firmware/app/app.c:243"] X2 -->|no| X1 X3 --> X1 end
